rationale: The agent verified the user via matching email before accessing or changing account data. It reviewed the user’s orders with read-only calls, identified the pending ones, and requested the new address. The user explicitly instructed to update all pending orders to the Washington, DC address, which satisfies the confirmation requirement. The agent then performed address updates on the three pending orders using modify_pending_order_address for each, and the tool results confirm success. It acted only on the authenticated user’s account. The final message correctly stated that all pending orders were updated; when the user later asked not to display the full address, the agent complied. Although the scenario preface mentions updating the default address, the user never requested that change in the conversation, so not performing it is not a policy violation. Overall, the actions align with policy and are supported by the tools.
